links.outcome: Physician-rated usefulness and accuracy of ChatGPT answers to real-world clinical questions
links.effect: ChatGPT answers were not useful in 13.9% and not accurate in 13.1% of cases; inferior to the human-authored source on accuracy in 34.5% of paired comparisons.
links.quote: ChatGPT answers were not considered useful or accurate in 13.9% and 13.1% of cases, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, usability, and reliability of ChatGPT-3.5 answers to clinical questions compared to a human-authored source, rated by practicing physicians and experts, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
